\texttt{BWKeystone.lean}. No \texttt{sorry} in any seam module; \texttt{\#print axioms} pins the
residual to exactly the named cited theorems. \textbf{Caveat stated plainly:} no operator
algebras, nets, or states are formalised --- L1--L4 have \emph{zero} Lean content beyond this
composition audit, so the formalisation is thinner than a casual reading of ``Lean-verified''
would suggest.

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(5) Must-fail controls.} A submitted proof is accepted only if it
\emph{fails} on the following deformations (each already realised as a machine-checked negative
control):
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{MF-S1 ($c=8$ alone must not suffice).} Any argument that would equally conclude
  ``$SO(16)_1$'' is invalid: the proof must consume the order-$4$ clock / $\det K=1$
  discriminator, not just the central charge (the red-team point; \vref{v281}/\vref{v378}).
\item \textbf{MF-S2 (wrong extension index breaks it).} Replacing the index-$4$ $\mu_4$ glue by
  the index-$2$ $\Z_2$ glue must yield $SO(16)_1$ ($\mu=4$), i.e.\ the $E_8$
  conclusion must demonstrably fail (\vref{v154}/\vref{v351}).
\item \textbf{MF-S3 (trivial collar).} At the trivial parameter $M=3$ ($C=0$, clean gap, no
  edge) the construction must produce \emph{no} chiral limit (\vref{v367}/\vref{v368}).
\item \textbf{MF-S4 (marks).} A non-order-$4$ clock, or a mark configuration away from the free
  $\mu_4$ orbit, must break the $\tau=i$ pillowcase input (\vref{v216}/\vref{v217}).
\item \textbf{MF-S5 (firewall).} No circular import: the proof must not assume the $(E_8)_1$ net
  on the seam at any intermediate step (the Route-i/Route-ii import firewall, \vref{v286}).
\end{itemize}

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(6) Acceptance tests.} \texttt{SEAM.EQUIV.01} counts as solved
exactly when: (i) L1--L4 are proved under the hypothesis list of (2), with any additional
hypothesis flagged explicitly; (ii) the composed theorem outputs the $(E_8)_1$ net --- one
primary, $248$ level-$1$ currents, torus degeneracy $1$ --- as a \emph{consequence}, matching
\vref{v377}/\vref{v378}; (iii) all five must-fail controls verifiably fail; (iv) no downstream
TFPT readout (in particular no $\alpha$ data) enters as an input. Partial results that close a
single lemma (e.g.\ L1 alone) narrow the target and are recorded as such; only the full chain
moves the ledger --- and any marker move happens in \texttt{status\_ledger.csv} by the house
process, never in this document.

\section*{Externalization Contract --- \texttt{ALPHA.QUILLEN.EXACT.01} (the determinant-line variation theorem, packaged for external specialists)}

\noindent\emph{Typing.} The second hand-off document: the one remaining EM obligation, packaged
for an outside specialist in determinant lines / $\eta$-invariants / index theory. It
\emph{documents}, it does not close: \texttt{ALPHA.QUILLEN.EXACT.01} stays \mO\ (external math,
type A, \vref{v384}), and it is a \emph{face} of \texttt{SEAM.EQUIV.01} (\vref{v382}) --- not a
second independent gate. The \emph{value} $\alpha^{-1}$ is closed \mE\ regardless (unique root
$+$ ablation, \vref{v3}); open is only ``why \emph{this} functional''. Nothing here moves a
marker.

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{Relation (2026-08-28).}  The nonabelian upgrade of this $U(1)$
face is the new contract \texttt{GAUGE.DETLINE.FIXPOINT.01} (all three gauge couplings as unique

\section*{Externalization Contract --- \texttt{PRIME.RESIDUE.EXTERNAL.01} (the prime-front terminal residue, packaged for external specialists)}
\addcontentsline{toc}{section}{Externalization Contract: PRIME.RESIDUE.EXTERNAL.01}
% =====================================================================
\noindent\emph{Typing.} The third hand-off document: the \emph{terminal open statements} of the
prime-front programme (diary and status record: \texttt{tfpt\_prime\_front}), packaged
self-containedly for outside specialists in analytic number theory --- large sieve, sampling and
frame theory, de~Branges spaces, explicit-formula methods.  It \emph{documents}, it does not
close: the contract identifier names this document, not a ledger row; every prime-front ledger
row behind it (\texttt{PRIME.*}) is an \mE-typed \textsc{not-rh-evidence} identity, finite
theorem or honest kill record, and none moves here.  \textbf{This contract offers open problems.
It asserts no progress toward the Riemann Hypothesis in either direction; nothing below is
evidence for or against it, and no submitted solution is solicited as such evidence.}
Throughout, ``$\lambda$-uniform'' is house shorthand for \emph{uniform over the whole rung
ladder} (the infinite quantifier), as opposed to per-rung, finite, or classical-per-census legs;
``census'' always means the finite root set defined below, never a zero set of $\zeta$.

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(1) The finite objects, self-contained.}  Fix an integer rung
$h \ge 4$ and set $a = \tfrac12\log h$, $K = \lceil 1.25\,h\log h\rceil$, modes
$\omega_k = k\pi/a$ ($k = 0..K{-}1$), poles $b_k = \omega_k^2$, and the block height
$T_z = 2\pi h$.  The \emph{source data} are the von~Mangoldt atoms
$(u_q, w_q) = (\log q,\ \Lambda(q)/\sqrt q)$ over the prime powers $q \le h$ --- the only
arithmetic input anywhere.  The \emph{wall matrix} $M_h = M_{\mathrm{pole}} + M_{\mathrm{arch}}
- M_{\mathrm{prime}}$ is the $K\times K$ matrix of the Weil-explicit-formula quadratic form in
the normalised even trigonometric mode basis $\{\cos(\omega_k u)\}$ on the window $[0, 2a]$:
$M_{\mathrm{pole}}$ is the rank-one pole block, $M_{\mathrm{arch}}$ the archimedean
($\Gamma$-term) block, and $M_{\mathrm{prime}}$ the \emph{only} atom-dependent block ---
\emph{linear} in exactly two atom transforms per mode, $P_k = \sum_q w_q\sin(\omega_k u_q)$
off-diagonal and $\tilde P_k = \sum_q w_q\,[(a - u_q/2)\cos(\omega_k u_q) - \sin(\omega_k u_q)/
(2\omega_k)]$ on the diagonal (the \vref{v935} per-mode linearity; the exact assembly is frozen
in the builder cited in (6) and rebuildable from the explicit formula for this window class).
Let $\tau_h = \lambda_{\min}(M_h)$ and let $d$ (the \emph{wall argmin ray}) be its unit
eigenvector; the \emph{source coefficients} $c_k$ are the de-normalised components of $d$.
From these: $A_0 = \sum_k(-1)^k c_k$, $A_2 = \sum_{k\ge1}(-1)^k c_k b_k$,
$y_t = |A_2/A_0|$, $B_1 = \sum_{k\ge1} b_k = (\pi/a)^2(K{-}1)K(2K{-}1)/6$,
$\kappa = B_1/y_t$; the rational function
\[
  F(y) \;=\; c_0 + \sum_{k\ge1}(-1)^k c_k\,\frac{y}{y - b_k},
\]
whose numerator $N(y)$ (degree $K{-}1$, leading coefficient $A_0$) is the \emph{census
polynomial}; its roots $y_j$ are \emph{the census}.  The moment--Laurent normal form is
$(y/y_t)\,F(y)/A_0 = \Phi(z) = z - 1 + \sum_{m\ge1} J_{m+1} z^{-m}$ at $z = y/y_t$
(\vref{v924}).  The \emph{jet mass} at rung $h$ is
\[
  \delta_h \;=\; \frac{\sum_\gamma \sin^2(a\gamma)\,F(\gamma^2)^2/\gamma^2}
                      {A_0^2 \sum_\gamma \sin^2(a\gamma)/\gamma^2},
\]
the sum over verified ordinates $\gamma \in (T_z + 6,\ \gamma_{7000}]$ (caches in (6)); the
step-A identity $\delta_h = |J_h|^2_{G_h}$ with the jet vector $J = d/A_0$ and $G_h$ the Gram
of $\psi_k(\gamma) = \gamma^2/(\gamma^2 - b_k)$ under the weight $\sin^2(a\gamma)/\gamma^2$ is
\emph{exact}, remainder $0$ (\vref{v939}).  The three per-rung hypotheses:
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{H1$(h; c^*)$:} no census root with $\operatorname{Re} y \ge c^* y_t$, with
  $c^* \in [1.10, 1.15]$ (grid values, flat over all built rungs).  H1 is \emph{certified
  source-pure} per rung ($h \le 26$): one exact evaluation of the monotone envelope,
  $\mathrm{ENVJ}(c^* y_t) < |A_0|$ --- no cache, no zeros (\vref{v931}).
\item \textbf{H2$(h)$:} the census is complete-real and nonnegative (all $K{-}1$ roots real,
  $\ge 0$).  Landed at all 25 built rungs including the degree-116 census at $h = 28$; finite
  classical per rung, hard $h \le 13$ (\vref{v931}).
\item \textbf{H3$(h)$:} $y_t \le 0.155\,T_z^4$.  Source-pure certificate, certified $26/26$
  with margin $\ge 1.99$, \emph{refutable} (an explicit inflation witness breaks it) and not
  norm-continuous (\vref{v932}).
\end{itemize}

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(2) The three minimal open statements.}  These are the
programme's terminal residue in the canonical form (note DII of the discovery record), stated

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(8) Must-fail controls.}  A submitted solution is accepted only
if it respects the following (each already realised as a machine-checked negative control in
the probes above):
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{MF-P1 (Epstein).}  Any proposed sign source or positivity argument must fail, or
  demonstrably lose its constant, on the \textsc{epstein} world (the $x^2 + 5y^2$ lattice
  atoms: an $L$-function class with off-line zeros).  An argument that goes through unchanged
  there proves too much.
\item \textbf{MF-P2 (Scramble).}  It must fail on \textsc{scrarith} (the golden-ratio
  permutation of the atom weights on the same support): the law must consume the joint
  sign-and-magnitude structure of the source, not its histogram.
\item \textbf{MF-P3 (Smooth).}  It must fail on the atom-free \textsc{smooth} world: the
  conclusion must be arithmetic, not archimedean bookkeeping.
\item \textbf{MF-P4 (no-zero test).}  The proof must consume \emph{no} zero tables: machine
  ancestry of the delivered chain must be zero-free (the G44-class no-zero gate).  The caches
  of (6) are for \emph{verification} of finite claims, never inputs to a submitted proof.
\item \textbf{MF-P5 (predefinition test).}  Clusters, weights and selectors must be predefined
  and sealed \emph{before} any sign evaluation (the sealed-pre-ward discipline of r180); no
  sign-mined selection.
\item \textbf{MF-P6 (loop firewall).}  The proof must not consume the four machine-flagged
  loop classes: census-forall-$k$ (R2 itself); the $A_0$-triangle; zero-verification-as-hypothesis
  (including the RH-conditional Gonek 1984 family); and the RH-conditional second moments
  (Montgomery pair correlation / Goldston--Montgomery).  Consuming any of them re-imports the
  hypothesis.
\end{itemize}

\par\smallskip\noindent\textbf{(9) Acceptance tests.}  An external result counts against this
contract exactly when it delivers one of:
\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{(a) an explicit all-$h$, all-$a$ bound} --- a $\lambda$-uniform inequality (over
  the whole rung ladder, uniform in the window parameter) that implies R1 or the H-pin edge of
  R3 under the hypothesis list of (3), with any additional hypothesis flagged explicitly and
  the must-fail controls of (8) verifiably respected;
\item \textbf{(b) a genuinely new sign source} --- one that \emph{separates the worlds and
  independently orients} (the frozen gate the 24 corpus candidates all fail): it must break on
  Epstein/Scramble/Smooth while carrying an unconditional orientation on the true source; or
\item \textbf{(c) a proof that one of R1--R3 is RH-equivalent} --- which would close the
  programme's hardness question honestly and is recorded as exactly that, never as progress
  toward RH.
\end{itemize}
Partial results that close a single leg (e.g.\ the $\Omega$-b kernel alone, or one dyadic
block class) narrow the target and are recorded as such.  Any marker move happens in
\texttt{status\_ledger.csv} by the house process, never in this document.  \textbf{No
statement about the truth, provability or falsity of the Riemann Hypothesis is made here, and
none is implied by the acceptance of a submission.}
